entry_points.text: Range bind installs policy with optional migration; task set installs and query copies mode plus mask; process migration moves address space after checks; home-node set updates bind areas locked.
Boot flag records balancing override; weighted sysfs offers weights group, per-node entries across hotplug, and auto control.

exports.text: Report fault-migration intent, OOM membership, slab node defaulting local; allocate area folios via effective policy and bulk via task policy outside interrupts.
Duplicate policy under task lock with cpuset rebind, compare mode flags masks and home, manage file range entries, drain trees, and detach task policy.
Create page structures over device intervals, manage lifetime-bound variants, drain references on teardown, and report required alignment.
Early-init policy caches and default, reset context to default, parse textual descriptions, and render policies to text.
Init device page spans with mapping and compound setup; migrate file, buffered and huge pages with checks; allocate targets routing hugetlb and large orders.

hazards.text: Invalid input is invalid; privilege is permission; alloc is no-memory; copy fault is bad address; strict shortfall is IO error; unknown task is no-process; device, parse, sysfs, weight faults add no-bandwidth or overlap with warnings; memtest destroys; misuse warns or retries.

invariants.text: Bind needs aligned start and privilege for system move, rounds length, rejects wrap; node load treats null as empty, rejects oversize, needs zero out-of-range words, clears tails.
Replace drops covered entries, trims edges, splits spanning ones; home update skips policyless and fails non-bind without rollback.
Equality needs matching mode, flags, home and masks except local ignores masks; slab uses first set, rotating or usable zone node with local fallback.
Bulk uses task policy outside interrupts; interleave spreads evenly, weighted issues one request per node from snapshot, preferred-many tries masked then falls back.
Null id means caller with destination filtered to allowed set; move rejects zero and device folios, skips on-target pages, and needs all-shared flag for shared maps.
Override sign controls balancing with single-node no-op; early init builds singletons and installs eligible set; parse and render enforce per-mode list rules.
Weight writes reject empty or zero, replace table and leave auto; auto needs bandwidth; device ranges reject misuse, overlap, missing callbacks; page spans derive from byte ranges.
Device init needs bounded order, clean state, no refs, zone identity; zero swap needs anonymous matching subpages; hugetlb rmap warns on multi exclusive.

locks.text: Bind and home hold address space exclusively with release before migration; task policy reads under task lock with RCU scratch sampling; shared tree mutates exclusively allocating outside lock.
Weighted table uses RCU with state mutex for writers and group mutex for links; device maps use hotplug exclusion with refcount drain on teardown.
Buffer migration locks buffers without folio lock via try or limited block; huge transfer freezes under iterator lock; user move holds read lock with LRU off.

state_machines.text: Bind runs validate, create, locked install and queue, update, unlock, migrate, strict-promote, cleanup; process migration runs scratch, load, check, migrate, release.
Replace mutates under lock, on missing node drops lock, allocates, restarts scan, and frees unused on failure.
Weighted cycles absent, manual, automatic by replacement; device commits incrementally, tears down on failure, then kills, drains, releases.
Memtest aligns, writes then rereads coalescing mismatches into reservations; entry removal rebuilds preserving flags; bulk move groups by node with per-page status.

structs.text: Policy holds mode, flags, masks, home, refcount with modes default-null, bind, prefer, prefer many, interleave, weighted interleave, local; file state holds lock and tree; bind context pairs policy with index.
Binding pairs attribute with node id; group holds object, mutex, per-node table; hierarchy uses mempolicy parent, numeric entries, auto control, unit default.
Stats track base and huge outcomes plus splits; walk arg pairs folio with zero flag; retry ten, async three; batch build-dependent; history two bits plus mask.
Alignment is subsection size; threshold sixteen megabytes; flags cover static or relative nodes, balancing, and move, move-all, strict, discontinuous tolerance.
